newsitem.title: USA: US T-bond yield dips below 7 pct, lowest in month.
newsitem.headline: US T-bond yield dips below 7 pct, lowest in month.

text.p: The benchmark U.S. Treasury bond yield dipped below 7.0 percent on Tuesday, the lowest yield in more than a month, as the market applauded softer than expected economic data.
The 30-year bond yield last ended below seven percent on March 26, when it closed at 6.98 percent.
Earlier, the government reported a smaller-than-expected 0.6 percent in the first-quarter Employment Cost Index and a 3.0 percent drop in March durable goods orders.
"The Street and retail were short going into these data so you might be getting more of a pop (higher) because of that," said one trader.
(( -- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
